text: PreparedDirectNeighborhoodExecutor now serializes every public run on the plan instance, protecting its reusable coordinate workspace without per-run allocation. Scaladoc and guide specify lifetime, caller ownership, no-retention, outside-mutation prohibition, mutable alias rejection, and separate-plan parallelism. JVM overlap test proves a second run cannot enter until the first returns. Existing shared JVM/JS reuse and alias tests remain green. Evidence: stencilJVM 27/27, stencilJS 24/24, directAllocated=0 B, booleanAllocated=0 B, fmtCheck and docsCheck passed.
